what.text: This page follows refugees from Kuwait in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3369 Kuwaiti refugees, and the United Kingdom hosted 60.6% of them.
After the United Kingdom, the largest hosts are France, Denmark and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Kuwait: an interstate armed conflict between Iraq and Kuwait in 1990 and 1991.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2021 to 2025, come long after that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1990 at 46 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
